definition_en: Risk ranking from calibrated and monotonically projected 14-, 30- and 60-day cumulative probabilities.
Direct prediction of 60-day event risk using an independently determined feature set and model.
Fraction of retained pre-evaluation observation days with chlorophyll-a at or above 75 micrograms per litre.
